jobs.title: Program Manager – Manufacturing Digitalization
jobs.description:
The Program Manager/Digitalization Lead is responsible for enabling, guiding, and accelerating regional manufacturing digitalization efforts while preserving plant ownership of execution. This role supports pilots and early deployments, builds regional capability through expert networks, and ensures successful reuse and scaling of proven digital solutions. The role provides decision-ready insights and structured roadmaps to regional and BU leadership, acting as a critical bridge between plant operations, automation/IT, and enterprise digital strategy.

Regional Program Manager/Digitalization Lead

Position Summary
The Digitalization Lead is responsible for enabling, guiding, and accelerating regional manufacturing digitalization efforts while preserving plant ownership of execution. This role supports pilots and early deployments, builds regional capability through expert networks, and ensures successful reuse and scaling of proven digital solutions. The role provides decision-ready insights and structured roadmaps to regional and BU leadership, acting as a critical bridge between plant operations, automation/IT, and enterprise digital strategy.
Key Roles & Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Standard Duties:

- Support and enable digitalization pilots and early-stage deployments across regional plants without assuming long-term execution ownership.
- Preserve and reinforce plant accountability while providing hands-on technical and application support as needed to ensure successful startup and stabilization.
- Lead and coordinate a regional network of digital and automation subject matter experts to provide aligned, timely support without overloading plant resources.
- Capture successful digital solutions and scale them through standardized playbooks, reusable architectures, and deployment patterns.
- Maintain and communicate a 30/60/90-day rolling regional digitalization execution roadmap, highlighting priorities, dependencies, and risks.
- Provide clear, decision-ready inputs and recommendations to regional leadership for escalation, prioritization, and resource alignment.
- Partner closely with plant leadership, manufacturing engineering, maintenance, IT, and corporate digital teams to translate operational needs into compliant, scalable solutions.
- Enable knowledge sharing and capability building across plants through best-practice exchanges, standards, and lessons learned.
- Execute digitalization enablement activities within priorities and direction established through regional digitalization governance

Other Duties:
This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time.
Additional Information:
Travel is required as needed to support regional plants and pilot deployments (expected up to ~30%).

Safety and Physical Requirements:
- All employees are responsible for knowing, understanding and complying with the safety policies and procedures.
- Wear PPE when appropriate in designated campus areas.

Key Competencies
Digital Enablement and Application Support  Systems Thinking and Integration  Change Management and Influence  Structured Problem Solving  Cross-Functional Collaboration. Decision Framing and Executive Communication
Education & Experience
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Manufacturing, Electrical, Controls, or similar discipline) required
- Advanced degree (MBA, MS Engineering, or similar) preferred
- 7+ years of experience in manufacturing, automation, or industrial digitalization roles
- Demonstrated hands-on experience with manufacturing systems (MES), dashboards, analytics, and data-driven decision support
- Strong working knowledge of automation systems including PLCs, SCADA, sensors, vision systems, and edge devices
- Proven understanding of OT/IT integration, industrial networking, cybersecurity, and IT governance in a manufacturing environment
- Ability to translate shop-floor problems into scalable, compliant digital solutions
- Experience supporting multi-site or regional manufacturing organizations strongly preferred

EEO Statement
“BorgWarner is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.”

ACKNOWLEDGMENT STATEMENT
I confirm that I have reviewed, feel adequately informed and understood the responsibilities and requirements of this job description.  I agree to adhere to these job responsibilities and requirements as outlined in this document.
Incumbent Signature

jobs.title: Program Management Intern
jobs.description:
Position
Program Management Intern
Location
Arden, NC

About Us
BorgWarner is a global product leader in delivering innovative and sustainable mobility solutions. We are a company of innovators and independent thinkers that brings together talented employees, meaningful work and amazing technology in a unique environment. At BorgWarner, we constantly work towards our vision of a clean and energy-efficient world.

Our Culture
BorgWarner promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive environment, honors integrity, strives for excellence, commits to responsibility for our communities and the environment, and builds on the power of collaboration.  We believe the health and safety of our employees are a top priority.

Career Opportunities
We manage talent as seriously as we manage our businesses and encourage you to learn about our proud history, strong culture, technologies, and vision for the future. We offer positions locally and globally with over 80 locations in 19 countries.

If this position energizes you and you feel you can help us achieve our mission and vision, you are invited to submit an application for consideration.

You may see the list of requirements and feel you do not meet all of them. However, remember that BorgWarner thinks differently. If your qualifications align with the majority of those outlined in this job description, we encourage you to apply and share your experience and skills with us.

For a listing of Asheville/Arden openings: BorgWarner Openings

Job Purpose
The BorgWarner Arden campus offers two world class technical centers and a cutting-edge manufacturing facility that designs and produces turbos, fan, and fan drive components for the automotive industry. The Arden campus offers a multitude of career opportunities and is in the beautiful mountains of Western North Carolina.

Reporting to Program Manager, responsible for organizing, coordinating, and executing a comprehensive project management regimen that meets customer expectations. Reporting to Manager, Program Management, support continuous improvement of existing Program Management processes/tools for Arden, NC.

Key Responsibilities
- Working with Manager, Program Management, evaluates and executes continuous improvement of existing Program Management processes and tools.
- Provides project management for customer programs, focusing on (1) the assertive oversight of product launches, (2) vigilant cost containment, avoidance, and reduction throughout a product’s life cycle, (3) a comprehensive communications effort
- Works at all levels of the organization to build a case for the program and gain the commitment of the department heads allowing the allocation of the necessary resources
- Interacts with customer teams to help develop and lead programs aimed at satisfying customer demands
- Serves as program owner, accountable for the execution and success of the program
- Leads the program team to achieve the financial results the program was approved on
- Develops programs from inception through completion of Quality Gate 6
- Leads customer program teams through established BW PM process. This would include but not be limited to strategic programs involving planning and defining objectives, product design and development, process design and development, product and process validation, and initial production performance
- Drives the APQP process to meet cost, timing, and delivery objectives in a TS16949 environment
- Ensures internal and external required documentation is delivered on time
- Creates and manages program timelines to meet critical milestones
- Manages financial outcomes of the programs
- Maintains program charter, timing plan, and gate review metrics and documentation
- Ensures customer team members are trained on BW PM process when needed
- Establishes and maintains communications with both customer personnel and senior management
- Effectively presents high-level information to senior management and customers
- Ensures that common inquires or complaints from customers and internal personnel are handled in a timely manner
- Develops relationships with customers that make the product launches an experience that contributes to awarding new business in the future
- Recognizes, identifies, and drives changes/improvements to BW PM process.
- Leads program team to meet APQP requirements and deadlines.
- Understands financial reports and engineering documents/data
- Understands and adheres to current quality and control policies
- Understands and adheres to current health, safety, and environmental policies
- Communicates and enforces safe work procedures
- Identifies and closes safety issues (suggestions, inspection, and investigation findings) and their corrective actions.
- Performs other duties as requested, directed, or assigned

What we are looking for
- In progress to Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or related discipline
- Experience working in cross/multi-functional teams preferred
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project) required
- Demonstrated team leadership experience preferred
- Technical competence, problem solving, organization, and communication skills required
- Familiarity with turbochargers and/or engines is preferred
- Solid understanding of engineering and manufacturing functions within the automotive supplier market segment preferred

What we offer
All positions start at an above market pay rate for that position. Benefits are also above market and include the below for all student employees:
- Retirement Savings Plan (401k) with a matching program
- All positions are paid opportunities based on college class standing
- Housing support and travel reimbursement according to policy requirements

Join the company that is creating solutions that support a cleaner, more energy-efficient world. For more information about BorgWarner, please visit www.borgwarner.com

jobs.title: Supplier Risk Program Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The Supplier Risk Program Manager is a key member of the Global Supplier Risk Management organization and reports to the Director or Senior Manager of Supplier Risk Management. The position is responsible for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and resolving supplier-related risks that could impact business continuity, operational performance, financial stability, customer service, and strategic sourcing decisions.

The role combines proactive and reactive risk management disciplines, capacity assessment, crisis management, insolvency prevention, force majeure response, operational recovery, contract risk mitigation, and supply chain resiliency initiatives. The Supplier Risk Program Manager serves as the central point of coordination between suppliers, purchasing, engineering, manufacturing, quality, finance, legal, and executive leadership teams.

The successful candidate will drive enterprise-wide risk mitigation strategies, support supplier continuity programs, lead crisis response activities, and continuously improve risk management processes, tools, and governance models.

#LI-Hybrid

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Risk Management
- Develop and implement global supplier risk management strategies.

- Establish and maintain supplier risk assessment frameworks covering operational, financial, capacity, geopolitical, environmental, and sustainability risks.

- Support sourcing decisions through comprehensive supplier risk evaluations.

- Create risk visibility and reporting systems for executive leadership.

- Integrate lessons learned from supplier crises into sourcing and commodity strategies.

- Participate in strategic supplier portfolio reviews and risk councils.

Financial Risk Management Background
- Understand supplier financial performance, liquidity, profitability, cash flow, and business outlook.

- Monitor supplier financial ratings and external risk indicators.

- Conduct financial stress tests and scenario analyses.

- Support insolvency prevention and restructuring initiatives.

Capacity and Operational Risk Management
- Evaluate supplier manufacturing capabilities, capacity utilization, and expansion plans.

- Conduct supplier operational assessments and gap analyses.

- Identify bottlenecks and process inefficiencies impacting supply continuity.

- Support supplier productivity improvement initiatives.

- Assess manufacturing resilience and long-term sustainability.

- Develop mitigation plans for capacity shortages and supply disruptions.

Crisis and Reactive Risk Management
- Lead crisis management activities related to:  - Supplier insolvencies

- - Force majeure events

- - Capacity shortages

- - Quality escapes

- - Natural disasters

- - Geopolitical disruptions

- - Plant shutdowns and wind-downs

- Act as primary point of contact during supplier crises.

- Coordinate cross-functional recovery teams.

- Develop and implement business continuity plans.

- Support supplier recovery, turnaround, and restructuring efforts.

- Ensure continuity of supply during critical disruptions.

Supplier Relationship Management
- Act as Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for high-risk suppliers.

- Facilitate communication between suppliers and internal stakeholders.

- Lead supplier reviews and executive escalation meetings.

- Support supplier audits and risk assessments globally.

- Coordinate corrective action plans and monitor execution.

Governance, Reporting and Compliance
- Prepare risk reports and executive summaries for leadership teams.

- Maintain risk dashboards, KPIs, and early warning systems.

- Develop and manage supplier risk management processes and standards.

- Support internal and external audits.

- Ensure compliance with corporate governance and regulatory requirements.

- Contribute to digitalization and automation initiatives within Risk Management.

Position Accountabilities
- Supplier Risk Assessment and Mitigation

- Financial Risk Evaluation and Reporting

- Capacity and Manufacturing Risk Analysis

- Crisis Management and Business Continuity Planning

- Supplier Insolvency and Restructuring Support

- Executive Risk Reporting

- Supply Chain Resiliency Development

- Cross-functional Risk Governance

- Supplier Performance Recovery Programs

- Continuous Improvement of Risk Management Processes

Qualifications

Education
- Bachelor's Degree in: Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Economics
- Master's Degree preferred (MBA, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain Management, or similar)

Experience
- Minimum 8 years of experience in:

- - Supply Chain Management

- - Purchasing / Strategic Sourcing

- - Supplier Quality

- - Manufacturing Operations

- - Supplier Development

- - Risk Management

- - Finance or Financial Analysis

Preferred:
- Automotive industry experience
- Experience with supplier distress, insolvency, or crisis management
- Global supplier management experience
- Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and processes

Technical Skills
- Supplier Risk Management

- Financial Statement Analysis

- Operations and Manufacturing Assessment

- Capacity Planning and Analysis

- Business Continuity Planning

- Supplier Auditing

- Contract Risk Assessment

- APQP and Quality Systems

- Lean Manufacturing Principles

- Root Cause Analysis

- Data Analytics and Reporting

- Risk Modeling and Scenario Analysis

- Fluent English proficiency is mandatory

Preferred:
- IATF 16949 / VDA 6.3 Audit Knowledge

- Power BI or Business Intelligence Platforms

- ERP Systems (SAP, Ivalua, etc.)

Leadership Competencies
- Strategic Thinking

- Decision Quality

- Problem Solving

- Customer Focus

- Drive for Results

- Conflict Management

- Organizational Agility

- Stakeholder Management

- Communication and Influence

- Change Management

- Team Leadership

- Executive Presence

Travel Requirements
- Approximately 30–50% international travel.

- Supplier visits, audits, crisis interventions, and plant support activities globally.

Success Measures
- Reduction of supplier-related disruptions.

- Improved supplier risk visibility and early warning effectiveness.

- Successful management of supplier crises and continuity events.

- Improved supplier financial and operational resilience.

- Timely executive reporting and risk escalation.

- Increased integration of risk management into sourcing decisions.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
General Description
Responsible for working with the program team to get program timing, quality and cost targets within specified scope. Guarantee customer satisfaction from program kickoff to 3 months after SOP.
Key Accountabilities
1. Support Sales to develop new business opportunities and program kickoff. Establish the initial project plan, Gate plan, define and gain essential resource for programs.
2. Establish and lead the regular programs review with team members, keep the 3 elements under tracking over whole program development.
3. Report the program management status to managers’ organization.
4. Working with project team and finance to define the program investment scheme, and support the investment request submission and approval.
5. Lead all the issues resolve and tracking. Identify and coordinate achievement of any resources which is outside of program team or organization.
6. Regular communications with customers to report our program status and collect customer requirements updates. Making alignment with customers.
7. Ensure smooth program transfer from Program Management to Production Operation.
8. Change management to make sure the smooth implementation.
Qualifications & Requirements
• Minimum 4 years of project experience in Automobile environment
• Strong communication and negotiation skills.
• Perfect Leadership and listening skills to establish and develop program team.
• Clear Results orientation.
• Strong conflicts management skills and dealing with ambiguity.
• Good capabilities of planning setting up, risk analysis and issues resolve.
• Knowledge of finance related concepts
• Good process principle knowledge of product design and process design.
• Fluent in English and in the customer language.
• Passion for excellence under pressure.
• Bachelor degree is basic, Master degree is preferred.
Key Competencies
• Business Acumen
• Priority Setting
• Customer Focus
• Informing
• Ethics and Values
• Action Oriented
• Drive for results
• Dealing with Ambiguity
• Listening
• Interpersonal Savvy

jobs.title: Program manager
jobs.description:
Milyen izgalmas kihívások várnak Rád nálunk?
- Te irányítod a programcsapatot annak érdekében, hogy az új programok bevezetése, valamint a már futó programok volumennövelése sikeresen megvalósuljon. Ennek során biztosítod a mérföldkövek teljesítését, valamint a pénzügyi, műszaki és minőségi célok elérését.
- Feladatod elsősorban a német vevőkhöz kapcsolódó turbófeltöltő programjaink kapacitásbővítésének levezénylése a nagymértékben megnövekedett vevői igények teljesítése érdekében.
- Gyorsan és konstruktívan kezeled a vállalaton belüli és kívüli konfliktusokat.
- Biztosítod a vevői és vállalati elvárásoknak való megfelelést, a pénzügyi mutatószámok teljesülését.
- Kapcsolattartóként ügyféltalálkozókon veszel részt, bizonyos esetekben te vezeted azokat.
- Olyan ügyfélkapcsolatokat alakítasz ki, amely a termékbevezetést pozitív élménnyé teszi, és hozzájárul a jövőbeni új üzleti lehetőségek elnyeréséhez.

Számítunk rád, ha:
- szakirányú diplomával rendelkezel (gazdasági/műszaki terület),
- magabiztosan tárgyalsz angolul és németül,
- legalább 5 évet dolgoztál autóiparban mérnöki vagy operációs területen,
- legalább 3 éves projekt- vagy programmenedzseri tapasztalattal bírsz,
- képes vagy befolyásolni és motiválni másokat,
- hatékonyan irányítasz csapatot mátrixszervezetben,
- rendelkezel tapasztalattal erőforrás-, feladat- és költségtervezés terén,
- magas szintű műszaki kompetenciával, problémamegoldó képességgel, valamint kiváló szervezési és kommunikációs készségekkel rendelkezel,
- érted a pénzügyeket a program- és üzleti mutatók szempontjából,
- mély rálátásod van a mérnöki és gyártási funkciókra az autóipari beszállítói piacon,
- vállalod az utazást, jellemzően Európán belül.

Amire nálunk számíthatsz:
- Rugalmas munkaidőben fogsz dolgozni és home office-ra is lesz lehetőséged.
- Extra szabadságra leszel jogosult már a munkaviszony elejétől.
- Összetett kompenzációs csomaggal értékeljük a munkádat: éves bónusz, havi br 49 000 Ft Cafeteria, nettó 50 Ft/km üzemanyag támogatás, kedvezménykártya.
